capability: Allows running powerful LLMs locally on your own hardware, offering maximum privacy and control for text generation and editing tasks.
integration_path: Requires setting up a local LLM environment (e.g., using `llama.cpp`). Can be controlled via Python scripts that interact with the local inference server.

name: Google AI Platform (Vertex AI)
cost: Pay-as-you-go, with a generous free tier for experimentation.
capability: Offers access to Google's large language models and tools for custom model training, enabling the creation of a personalized AI writing assistant for tone and style.
integration_path: Python SDK available. Can be called from Python scripts. Integration with Google Workspace (Gmail) is possible via APIs.

name: GPT-2 (self-hosted)
cost: Open Source. Requires computing resources for self-hosting.
capability: An earlier but still capable LLM that can be fine-tuned to generate text in a specific style, useful for editing correspondence.
integration_path: Can be integrated into Python applications. Fine-tuning is possible but may be more resource-intensive than newer models.

name: LangChain (with various LLMs)
cost: Open Source (MIT License). Cost depends on the underlying LLM used (e.g., OpenAI API, Hugging Face models).
capability: A framework for developing applications powered by LLMs, facilitating the creation of custom writing assistants that can manage tone, format, and focus.
integration_path: Python library. Designed for easy integration with various LLMs and custom logic. Can abstract away direct API calls.

name: Open-Source LLM with Fine-tuning (e.g., Llama 3)
cost: Free (requires self-hosting and compute resources)
capability: A powerful open-source large language model that can be fine-tuned on John Loucks' own email and proposal data to learn his specific tone, format, and style.
integration_path: Self-host the LLM and use its Python API to send correspondence for editing. Fine-tuning would require a dedicated ML workflow.

name: LangChain with a local LLM (e.g., Mistral 7B)
cost: Free (requires self-hosting of LLM and LangChain)
capability: LangChain provides frameworks to chain together LLM calls and other components, allowing for custom AI assistants that can enforce tone, format, and focus on business correspondence when integrated with a local LLM.
integration_path: Set up a local LLM (like Mistral 7B) and use LangChain's Python SDK to build custom agents for email editing. This can be triggered via Python scripts.

name: GPT-4 (via OpenAI API, potentially using existing subscription if available)
cost: Pay-as-you-go API calls (potentially covered by existing business subscriptions)
capability: Can be instructed via prompts to rewrite emails for tone, format, focus, and attitude, and can learn a specific style with few-shot examples. Its API allows for Python integration.
integration_path: Utilize the OpenAI Python library to send correspondence to the GPT-4 API with specific instructions for editing. Requires API key and careful prompt engineering.

name: Google Gemini (via Google AI Studio or Vertex AI, potentially using existing Google Workspace)
cost: Free tier with limits, or potentially included in existing Google Workspace subscriptions
capability: Offers powerful AI capabilities for text generation and editing that can be guided to match specific tones and formats, with Python SDKs for integration.
integration_path: Use the Google AI Python SDK to interact with Gemini models. Can be integrated into Python scripts for email processing. Leverage Google Workspace integration if available.

name: OpenAI API (GPT-4)
cost: Pay-as-you-go, free credits often available for new users. Pricing details on OpenAI's website.
capability: Provides powerful language models capable of sophisticated text rewriting, tone adjustment, and format adherence via API.
integration_path: Python client library available. Can be integrated via REST API calls to the GPT-4 endpoint for text processing.

name: Google Workspace AI (Duet AI for Workspace - Free Tier)
cost: Free tier within Google Workspace (specific limits apply, likely sufficient for individual use).
capability: Offers AI-powered writing assistance directly within Gmail, capable of suggesting rephrasing for tone and clarity.
integration_path: Directly integrated into Gmail. Can potentially be accessed programmatically via Google Workspace APIs for more advanced automation if available.

name: Hugging Face Transformers (for Text Generation/Style Transfer)
cost: Free (open-source library, requires hardware for running models)
capability: Provides access to a vast array of pre-trained NLP models that can be adapted for text rewriting and style transfer tasks.
integration_path: Install the `transformers` library in Python. Load a suitable model and tokenizer. Implement custom Python scripts for API-like calls to rewrite text.

name: OpenAI API (GPT-3.5 Turbo - Free Credits/Tier)
cost: Free tier/credits available for new users, then pay-as-you-go. GPT-3.5 Turbo is very cost-effective.
capability: Powerful LLM accessible via API that can be prompted to rewrite text for specific tones, formats, and to maintain focus.
integration_path: Use the OpenAI Python client library to make API calls. Craft specific prompts to guide the AI's rewriting based on desired tone and format.

name: Writer.com (Free Tier)
cost: Free tier offers basic AI writing assistance and style guide adherence for individuals.
capability: Helps maintain brand voice and style consistency, with some capabilities for checking tone and clarity.
integration_path: Web application. Python integration may be possible via their API if the free tier supports it, but advanced features are likely paid.

name: LLaMA (Meta AI - Self-hosted)
cost: Free (open-source weights available under license). Requires significant compute resources for self-hosting and fine-tuning.
capability: A powerful open-source LLM family that can be fine-tuned for a wide range of writing tasks, including style and tone adjustments, when self-hosted.
integration_path: Requires significant technical expertise for self-hosting and integration. Python libraries can interact with hosted models.

name: Hugging Face Transformers (various LLMs)
cost: Open source models are free to download and use. Self-hosting incurs infrastructure costs.  Many models have free inference APIs with rate limits.
capability: Provides access to a vast collection of open-source LLMs that can be fine-tuned or used with prompt engineering for writing assistance, tone adjustment, and format control.
integration_path: Use Python library (transformers) to load and run models locally or via Hugging Face Inference API.  Requires more technical setup for self-hosting and fine-tuning.

name: LLaMA 3 (via Ollama or local deployment)
cost: LLaMA 3 model weights are freely available. Ollama provides a free local deployment. Self-hosting incurs infrastructure costs.
capability: A powerful open-source LLM that can be deployed locally to provide writing assistance, including tone, format, and style adjustments, with strong privacy benefits.
integration_path: Deploy LLaMA 3 using Ollama and interact with its REST API from Python.  Self-hosting provides maximum privacy and control.
